body: Direct smoketest of cmdBattlegrounds's exact real call sequence (CreateCharacter/GetCharacter/MintBattlegroundsTicket) against the live IDUNA service confirmed all three real, fast (ms-scale, not the tens-of-seconds a flaky telnet harness suggested), and correct -- the strongest confirmation this identity/ticket chain has had. Found Xvfb/glxinfo now work in this environment (Mesa software GL renders correctly), correcting a stale 'no display' note from earlier sessions. Interactive telnet validation of the command's own text output was attempted repeatedly and abandoned as test-harness noise, not a code bug. Full match-play validation (draft/cast/skillchain/credit) not attempted -- two real blockers named (Warrior's bot AI leads with R not Q, so it never naturally opens the one real chain pairing; GUI-input automation wasn't built). Milestone marked PARTIAL, not DONE, honestly. Commit 05d65b2.
